Write simulated sessions as folders for MFOs()

Source: R/simulate_MFO_sessions.R
write_MFO_sessions.Rd

Writes each participant and session of a [simulate_MFO_sessions()] result as a folder `<id>_<session>` (e.g. `P01_S1`) with three xlsx files, the layout that `MFOs(from = "folder")` reads. The participant ID in the `MFOs()` summary is then the folder name. A file `sessions.csv` in `path` maps each folder name (`id`) to its `participant` and `session`; `MFOs()` ignores it, as it reads only folders.

Usage

write_MFO_sessions(
  sim,
  path,
  db_basal_name = "basal_df",
  db_MFO_name = "MFO_df",
  db_graded_name = "VO2max_df",
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

sim

result of [simulate_MFO_sessions()].

path

folder where the participant folders are written (created if needed).

db_basal_name, db_MFO_name, db_graded_name

file names without the extension (defaults as the example data).

overwrite

logical; if `FALSE` (default), existing participant folders stop the function.

Value

The folders written, invisibly.

See also

[simulate_MFO_sessions()], [MFOs()]

Examples

sim <- simulate_MFO_sessions(2, 2, population = list(VO2max = c(3000, 0)),
                             seed = 1)
out <- file.path(tempdir(), "sim")
write_MFO_sessions(sim, out)
list.files(out)
#> [1] "P01_S1"       "P01_S2"       "P02_S1"       "P02_S2"       "sessions.csv"
